facts.text: Allgood got its name in December 1915 when a postmaster changed the village's spelling to his surname after a local lime maker complained about the confusing name Chepultepec.
Founded in 1909, Allgood has evolved from humble beginnings into a vibrant town that celebrates its heritage while embracing progress.
A spur track from the L&N Railroad to a local lime plant let Allgood ship lime to other countries.
The historic L&N Depot Station in Allgood once transported cross ties, cotton, cream, eggs, lime, cement, fertilizer, and farm products.
Allgood was formally incorporated in 1959, marking its transition from a precinct to an official town.
Allgood sits in south‑central Blount County’s Murphree Valley, flanked by Straight Mountain to the southeast and Red and Sand Mountains to the northwest.
